title: Notification System
features:
sends notifications

This is meant to act like a table, you can change it to not be a return but a table.

Example:
Notif.NewNotification('journey.lol', 'test', 5, {
            Callback = function(callback)
                if callback then
                    print(callback)
                end
            end,
            Button1 = 'Accept',
            Button2 = 'Decline'
        })
script:
return {
        NewNotification = function(title, txt, dur, buttons)
            local starterGui = cloneref(game:GetService('StarterGui'))
            local packet = {
                Title = title,
                Text = txt,
                Duration = dur
            }

            for i,v in buttons do
                packet[i] = v
            end

            starterGui:SetCore('SendNotification', packet)
        end
    }
